user.title: Connect Stillframe
user.description: Enter the frame's web address and username. Leave the password empty when Require password is off on the frame. The frame must support Stillframe LAN API v1.

data.password: Frame password (optional when disabled on frame)

reauth_confirm.title: Update frame password

data.password: Frame password (optional when disabled on frame)

reauth_confirm.description: Enter the frame password, or leave it empty when Require password is off on the frame.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the address, network and that the frame has LAN API v1 firmware.

abort.wrong_device: The address now belongs to a different frame.

edit_periods.title: Album periods and timezone
edit_periods.description: Use a JSON list of periods with start, end and album_ids. See the repository README for an example. Empty IDs means all enabled sources. Available albums: {albums}

init.title: Advanced schedules (Home Assistant)
init.description: Configure album and display mode schedules here. They are saved and run on the frame, even while Home Assistant is offline. Daily hours are shared with the app; edit them on the device page.

add_period.title: Add album period
add_period.description: Choose albums already synced to this frame. Leave albums empty for all enabled sources. Times use the frame timezone; periods cannot overlap.

add_mode_period.title: Add display mode period
add_mode_period.description: Choose when to use a display mode. Times use the frame timezone. Mode periods cannot overlap each other; they can overlap album periods. Frame settings follows the frame’s existing layout and automatic rotation preferences.

edit_mode_periods.title: Edit display mode periods
edit_mode_periods.description: Use a JSON list of periods with start, end and display_mode. Modes: auto, fullscreen, side_by_side, mosaic, collage, pile. See the repository README for an example. Set the frame timezone under Edit periods and timezone.

error.invalid_periods: Enter a JSON list of periods.
error.cannot_save: Could not save. Check the connection, HH:MM times, album IDs or display modes, and that periods within each schedule do not overlap.
